description: Multi-axis document classification. Each axis is independent. The classifier answers ALL axes per file, not one flat code.

physical_home.description: WHERE the file physically lives. Exactly one. This is the folder destination.

values.00_ORIENTATION: Inbox, navigation, governing docs, templates, handoffs
values.10_ACTIVE_EFFORTS: Files belonging to a named project with a goal and finish line
values.20_KNOWLEDGE_ATLAS: Reusable concepts, definitions, terms, models, mechanisms, domains
values.30_SOURCES: External material: papers, books, scripture, datasets, transcripts, web captures
values.40_CANONIZATION: Files in the epistemic pipeline: candidates, evaluated, or canon
values.50_PRODUCTION: Files headed for publication: articles, series, books, social, video, submissions
values.60_MEDIA_DATA: Binary media, structured data, databases, embeddings, model outputs
values.70_PEOPLE_WORLDVIEWS: People profiles, traditions, worldviews, rival models, comparisons
values.80_SYSTEM: Code, tools, automation, pipelines, configs, prompts, infrastructure
values.90_ARCHIVE: Superseded, old drafts, snapshots, backups, dead forks
values.99_REVIEW: Needs human decision: duplicates, low confidence, conflicts, quarantine

physical_subfolder.description: The specific subfolder within the physical_home. Drawn from the exhaustive structure on disk. The classifier proposes; David approves.

document_type.description: WHAT the file IS as a production artifact. Exactly one.

values.support_paper: Backs up or extends a canonical claim
values.formal_paper: Academic-grade paper with citations and methodology
values.lean_file: Lean 4 source code for formal verification
values.media: Image, audio, video, or binary asset
values.index: Table of contents, map, or navigation document
values.prompt: AI prompt, session export, or crew brief
values.note: Working note, scratch, brainstorm, or session log
values.receipt: Operations log, sort receipt, migration receipt
values.ruling: David's recorded decision on an open question
values.submission: Grant application, journal submission, cover letter

epistemic_roles.description: WHAT the file DOES in the knowledge system. A file can serve multiple roles. Non-exclusive.

values.claim: Makes a truth-apt assertion that can be tested
values.evidence: Provides empirical observation, measurement, or data
values.proof: Provides formal derivation or logical demonstration
values.process: Documents a methodology or derivation chain
values.falsifier: Defines a kill condition or failure criterion
values.objection: Presents the strongest argument against a claim
values.ruling: Records David's decision on an open question
values.model: Presents a thought experiment or test case
values.historical_case: Argues from textual or historical evidence
values.scripture_anchor: Grounds a claim in specific scripture
values.none: File has no epistemic role (media, config, receipt, etc.)

subject_domains.description: WHAT DOMAIN(S) the file operates in. Non-exclusive — cross-domain work gets multiple.

values.physics: Classical mechanics, quantum, relativity, thermodynamics, EM, nuclear
values.information: Shannon theory, entropy, channel capacity, coding
values.mathematics: Pure math, logic, proof theory, set theory, topology
values.morality: Ethics, moral philosophy, sin, virtue, corruption, justice
values.scripture: Biblical text, exegesis, hermeneutics, textual criticism
values.history: Historical events, church history, ancient near east
values.sociology: Cultural analysis, moral decline, institutional behavior
values.economics: Economic theory, money, markets, thermodynamic economics
values.theophysics: Cross-domain: the framework itself, master equation, ten laws

lifecycle.description: WHERE the file is in its lifecycle. Exactly one.

canon_status.description: WHERE the file is in the canonization pipeline. Exactly one. ONLY David can set 'admitted'.

values.not_evaluated: Has not entered the canonization pipeline
values.evaluated: Reviewed but not yet ruled on
values.admitted: DAVID ONLY. Admitted to canon by recorded ruling.
values.superseded: Was canon, now replaced by a newer ruling
values.withdrawn: Pulled back by David before ruling

rules: The classifier NEVER assigns 'admitted'. That requires David's recorded ruling with a ruling_id.
The classifier MAY propose 'candidate' or 'evaluated' based on content quality and completeness.

series.description: Which named series the file belongs to, if any. From the series registry.

effort.description: Which active project/effort the file belongs to, if any.

chi_primary.description: The dominant Master Equation variable. Single letter.

values.CHI: System-level: the equation itself, not one variable

chi_secondary.description: Other Master Equation variables present. Non-exclusive.

candidate_objects.description: Load-bearing propositions INSIDE the file. Up to 8. Each gets its own epistemic_role, a verbatim quote (max 40 words), and a note on why it's load-bearing. Every object starts as CANDIDATE_DRAFT — NOT ADMITTED.

shape.quote: verbatim from the text, max 40 words

output_shape.description: What the classifier returns per file

example.reason: Law 1 paper mapping Newtonian gravitation to sin/grace with cross-domain structural correspondence

candidate_objects.quote: Grace is the only frame-independent quantity in the moral domain
candidate_objects.note: Central thesis of the paper, maps to general covariance

candidate_objects.quote: The inverse-square law of gravitation maps structurally to the inverse-square decay of unrepented sin
candidate_objects.note: Primary cross-domain isomorphism, testable against Law 5

open_questions: Does the grace frame-independence claim survive the Law 8 frame apparatus?

rules: R1: Nothing is moved, renamed, or edited. Output goes to OUTBOX only.
R2: Rules engine runs first (extension, filename). LLM only for prose files rules didn't resolve.
R3: canon_status 'admitted' is NEVER assigned by the classifier. Requires David's recorded ruling.
R4: Every axis gets an answer. 'unknown' or 'none' is a valid answer — empty is not.
R5: candidate_objects quotes must be VERBATIM from the excerpt. Non-verbatim quotes are flagged.
R6: Cached by sha256 + taxonomy_hash + prompt_version. Same file won't re-classify unless something changes.
R7: physical_home decides the folder. All other axes become frontmatter properties.
R8: Disagreement between rule engine and LLM goes to 99_REVIEW.
R9: Confidence below 0.5 on physical_home goes to 99_REVIEW.
R10: Files that qualify for multiple physical_homes go to the one matching their PRIMARY function. The others appear through Base views.
